title: Verification Requirements by Payout Methods Rail
content:
A new payout method on any Payout Methods rail is verified by the rail's own verification method, within the rail's verification deadline, counted in calendar days after the method was added, and with a limited number of failed attempts allowed before the method is discarded.

| Rail | How the method is verified | Verification deadline (calendar days after adding) | Failed attempts allowed before the method is discarded | Account holder name must match the host's legal or business name |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH) | Micro-deposits | 10 | 3 | Yes |
| Fast Pay Debit Card | Card authorization | 3 | 3 | Yes |
| PayPal | Account link | 3 | 3 | Yes |
| Payoneer | Account link | 7 | 3 | Yes |
| International Wire Transfer | Document review | 14 | 3 | Yes |
| Western Union Cash Pickup | Identity match | 7 | 3 | Yes |

## The account each rail pays into

| Rail | Country | Currency | Account the method is opened on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH) | US | USD | A US checking or savings account in the host's name |
| Fast Pay Debit Card | US | USD | A US Visa or Mastercard debit card in the host's name |
| PayPal | — | — | A verified PayPal account whose name matches the host |
| Payoneer | — | — | A Payoneer account in the host's name |
| International Wire Transfer | — | — | A bank account outside the US in the host's name, reachable by SWIFT |
| Western Union Cash Pickup | MX | — | A Western Union receiver profile matching the host's identity document |

A dash means no condition of that kind is attached to the account itself.

## Points of reference

- **Shortest deadlines:** Fast Pay Debit Card and PayPal, at 3 calendar days after the method was added.
- **Longest deadline:** International Wire Transfer, at 14 calendar days, verified by document review.
- **Attempts:** every rail allows 3 failed verification attempts.
- **Name match:** on every rail the account holder name must match the host's legal name or business name.

**Hypothetical reading.** An imagined Payoneer method added on a given day has 7 calendar days after that day for its account link to be verified, and up to 3 failed attempts; an imagined International Wire Transfer method has 14 calendar days and is verified by document review.
